title: Such a Huge Puddle!
summary: The biggest dinosaur in the whole valley is terrified of the tiniest thing you can imagine.

scenes.text:
Rocco was the biggest animal in the whole valley. When he walked, the ground rumbled boom, boom, boom under the feet of the dinosaur.

In the trees, everything shook: the branches and the leaves. Everyone thought Rocco wasn't scared of anything. But he kept a very tiny secret.

Next to his nest there was a puddle. Not a river, not a lake: a teeny puddle, the size of a hat. And every time he saw it shine, his giant knees wobbled and he hid his big head behind his tail.

"What if it splashes me? What if it swallows me?", he thought, trembling because of such a small puddle.

To avoid getting close to the puddle, Rocco did very funny things. He took the longest way around the valley. He walked on tiptoe, slowly, glancing sideways.

One day, trying to dodge it, he made such a clumsy hop that he sat right on top of a bush. His crest was ruffled by a puff of wind. The birds watching him let out a giggle.

"Hee, hee, hee," they sang among the branches. Rocco turned red all the way to the tip of his tail. "I'm not scared!",

he said loudly. But the moment the puddle shone again, he ran off and hid behind a rock. An enormous dinosaur, hiding from something so small.

Out of the puddle popped, plip, a small green frog.

She sat on a floating leaf and looked at Rocco with kind eyes. "Why are you scared of the water?", she asked.

"It's only a puddle. I live here, and it's soft and cool." The frog splashed slowly, without any fear.

"Come on, just dip one toe," she said. Rocco gulped. He stretched out the biggest foot in the valley, slowly, slowly...

and touched the water. Nothing bad happened. The water tickled him.

The frog smiled.

"See? The puddle doesn't bite," she said. And Rocco, for the very first time, did not run away.

Then Rocco took a deep breath, counted to three and... he jumped into the puddle!

SPLASH! The water flew up and fell like happy rain. From every side came bubbles: fat ones, small ones, round ones.

Rocco stayed still for a second... and then let out a huge belly laugh. "Ha, ha, ha!

Nothing happens! It's soft!" He splashed and splashed, sprinkling the frog, who laughed with him.

The puddle, which had seemed like a monster before, was now the best toy in the valley.

The biggest dinosaur wasn't scared of the smallest puddle anymore.

He had only needed a little bit of courage.

When night came, the valley turned quiet and blue. Rocco and the frog sat together beside the puddle. In the still water, round and white like a silver button, shone the moon.

All around, like crumbs of light, twinkled the stars. An owl sang softly from a tree. "Good night, brave one," whispered the frog.

Rocco gave a big yawn, rested his head on his paws and smiled. His knees didn't wobble anymore. He closed his eyes slowly and fell asleep listening to the water sing.

And he dreamed he was jumping in a thousand puddles, happy, with no fear, until morning.
